Die Läufe sind braun befiedert; die frei: The tarsi are feathered brown; the bare toes are yellow.
Auch im Jugendkleid sind die Läufe bis z: In juvenile plumage too, the tarsi are feathered down to the yellow toes.
Rostroter Schwanz und dunkles Bauchband: A rufous tail and a dark belly band mark the adult plumage. The sexes are similarly coloured; females are larger on average.
Feine Querbänder zeichnen die helle Unte: Fine barring marks the pale underparts. Females are clearly larger and often somewhat browner than the rather blue-grey males.
Das Gefieder reicht von sehr hell bis du: The plumage ranges from very pale to dark brown. These colour variants occur in both sexes.
Schiefergrauer Rücken, dunkler Bartstrei: Slate-grey back, dark moustachial stripe and barred underparts. Females share the same basic pattern but are clearly larger.
Dunkelbraunes Gefieder mit goldbraunem N: Dark brown plumage with a golden-brown nape. The sexes differ mainly in size; females are usually more powerful.
Heller brauner Kopf, gelber Schnabel und: Pale brown head, yellow bill and white tail in adult plumage. Females are similarly coloured but usually larger and heavier.
Weißer Kopf und Schwanz über einem dunke: White head and tail above a dark brown body. Both sexes wear this adult plumage; females are larger on average.
Weiße Schultern und ein weißer Keilschwa: White shoulders and a white wedge-shaped tail contrast with the dark plumage. Females are similarly coloured but usually much heavier.
Ein dunkles Brustschild setzt sich vom h: A dark breast shield stands out against the pale belly. Both sexes wear the grey-and-white adult plumage; females are larger on average.
Orange Augen, Federohren und ein dicht g: Orange eyes, ear tufts and densely patterned brown-and-buff plumage. The sexes are similarly coloured, but females are clearly larger.
Dunkelbraunes Gefieder mit leicht gegabe: Dark brown plumage with a slightly forked tail. Males and females can hardly be told apart by plumage.
Rostroter Schwanz, heller Kopf und auffa: Rufous tail, pale head and strikingly pale patches under the wings. Both sexes are similarly coloured.
Hier ist die graue Farbvariante dargeste: The grey colour variant is shown here; there are also pale and very dark gyrfalcons. The colour variants do not depend on sex.
Braune Oberseite und eine helle, dunkel: Brown upperparts and pale, dark-marked underparts. Females are larger but largely the same in plumage.
Heller Kopf mit rostbraunem Scheitel und: Pale head with a rufous crown and a narrow dark moustachial stripe. Females are larger; the plumage pattern differs only slightly.
Dunkler Kopf, schiefergraue Oberseite un: Dark head, slate-grey upperparts and rufous feathering on the legs. Both sexes show this pattern; females are usually larger.
